about_the_game:
Customize your board with a host of new pieces. Want to start with an aggressive forward assault? Or perhaps a defensive fortress designed to weather the storm?

Forge your own chessboards with custom layouts, obstacles, or dynamic elements. Compete online, challenge the AI, or share your clever setups with the community

Whether you’re a chess master or a strategy enthusiast, Chessemble delivers endless tactical possibilities.

Example New Pieces:

  • Fusefort: Explodes on capturing/capture, destroying all pieces on that square and to the sides

  • Spearman: pawn who can sidestep and lunge forward to attack 2 spaces ahead

  • Cracked Pawn: a cheaper & weaker pawn, allowing you to purchase more powerful pieces elsewhere

  • Warden: A castle that somehow learned to jump, though now he can only reach 2 spaces

  • C4D4: Self-destructs destroying a part of the board for both players

Features:

  • Custom Board Forging: Create custom boards with new layouts,

  • Unique Pieces: 11+ new chess pieces.

  • Modes: Test strategies against AI, or play online.

Full Game Roadmap:

  • Expanded roster of unique pieces with diverse abilities.

  • Improved online matchmaking and leaderboards.

  • Ranked play

  • Advanced board customization, including traps and interactive elements.

  • in-game tools to share and test
